title: Presentation at Innovation Academy banner and large timeline screen
objects_and_counts: At least nine people are visible: five seated audience members in the foreground (region: lower left to center; some are partially cropped) and four presenters or standing participants at the front near the screen and banner (region: center to right).
One person at center-front is holding a handheld microphone (region: centre, standing in front of the screen).
One large wall-mounted display screen or LED panel is visible (region: centre-left) showing a slide headed 'IMPLEMENTATION PLAN & TIMELINE'.
One tall roll-up banner reading 'Innovation Academy' is positioned to the right of the screen (region: right-center).
One laptop is visible on a small table being used by a standing person (region: right-center).
Three modular cube seats are visible in the foreground: two blue cubes and one grey cube (region: lower center-left).
One white mobile standing desk or laptop trolley with wheels is visible against the right wall (region: far right).
One hanging brass bell is mounted on the wall to the right of the banner (region: upper right).
Several visible cable runs lie on the floor in front of the banner and running toward the right wall (region: center-right floor).
One wall-mounted exit sign with right-arrow and running-man icon is visible above a doorway (region: upper right).
Multiple posters are affixed to the right wall near the banner; they are visible but mostly not legible at full detail (region: right).
spatial_relations: The large display screen is centered on the front wall slightly left of the image center; a presenter stands directly in front of it.
To the right of the screen is a tall roll-up banner reading 'Innovation Academy', and immediately to the right of that banner is a doorway with an exit sign above it.
A small table with a laptop is located between the roll-up banner and the standing participants on the right; two standing people are using the laptop while another stands nearby.
Audience seating (blue and grey cube seats) is arranged in the foreground facing the screen and presenters; seated viewers have laptops in front of them.
A white mobile standing desk/trolley sits against the right wall to the right of the posters and beneath the hanging bell.
colours_and_materials: The ceiling beams and soffit near the front are painted a light mint green.
Foreground seating includes blue and grey upholstered cube seats.
The floor is covered with a light grey carpet with linear texture.
The roll-up banner has a dark (near-black or dark green) background with yellow and white text.
A brass-coloured bell is mounted on the right wall; exposed metal ductwork (silver) is visible near the ceiling above the doorway.
uncertainties: Exact total number of people in the room cannot be confirmed because parts of the space and reflections contain additional persons that are partially cropped or obscured.

Many lines of text on the slide under the heading 'IMPLEMENTATION PLAN & TIMELINE' are too small or partially obscured to transcribe accurately; only the heading and the words 'Phase 1' and 'Phase 2' were reliably legible.

Smaller repeated lines of text on the roll-up banner and on the posters at right are not fully legible; only the prominent 'Innovation Academy' and 'Faculty of Engineering' labels could be transcribed with confidence.
The sign on the far right shows 'FACULTY' but adjacent words above or beside it are partially cropped and unreadable.
Some objects (for example additional seats or equipment behind the audience and reflections in the glass) are visible only in part and therefore were not included in an exact count.
